label: Create Voice
description: Mint a preview from Design Voice or Remix Voice into a durable voice on the account. The minted voice id works in every speak node from then on.

inputs.name: account
inputs.description: Your own ElevenLabs account (the minted voice lives in it; the shared credential cannot serve this).

inputs.name: name
inputs.description: The new voice's name on the account.

inputs.name: description
inputs.description: The voice's description, kept with the voice, in 20 to 1000 characters.

inputs.name: previewId
inputs.description: The chosen preview's voiceId, from Design Voice or Remix Voice.

inputs.name: labels
inputs.description: Labels to store with the voice, each a name and a value, like `{ "language": "en" }`.

outputs.name: voiceId
outputs.description: The minted voice's id: what the speak nodes take.

outputs.name: previewUrl
outputs.description: A link to ElevenLabs's preview of the voice, when it answers one.

outputs.name: labels
outputs.description: The labels ElevenLabs keeps on the voice.

then.message: ElevenLabsCreateVoice '{id}' has a `description` under 20 characters, and ElevenLabs takes 20 to 1000: describe the voice in more detail.
ElevenLabsCreateVoice '{id}' has a `description` over 1000 characters, and ElevenLabs takes 20 to 1000: shorten it.
